aboutText: At Hai Constructions, we bring years of carpentry expertise to Sunshine North and surrounding areas. Our team, led by Ameem, specialises in adaptive construction and stick-building new homes. We pride ourselves on dedication to quality and adapting to project changes mid-construction. Choose us for your next project to experience the difference in craftsmanship.
servicesText: From renovations to custom builds, we offer a wide range of carpentry services. Our skilled team handles everything from decking to cabinetry, ensuring quality workmanship across Sunshine North.
